name: Snargl's Snout
summary: Neza Bloodsnout seeks Snargl's snout as a trophy. The elder gnoll's unpleasant sounds trouble allies and scouts in the Bristle Hills.

sections.title: A Trophy for Neza
sections.body: Neza Bloodsnout wants a memento for a collection, and Snargl is the gnoll she names. You are sent to the Bristle Hills to retrieve his snout. Neza expects you to be swift; the allies and scouts entering that area face trouble from Snargl's sounds.

faq.answer: Snargl is an elder gnoll in the Bristle Hills southwest of Neza Bloodsnout.

faq.q: Why does Neza want Snargl's snout?
faq.answer: Neza wants Snargl's snout as a memento for a trophy collection.
Snargl is in the Bristle Hills, southwest of Neza Bloodsnout.
Snargl makes unpleasant sounds that trouble allies and scouts who enter the Bristle Hills.

faq.q: What does Neza say when you return?
faq.answer: Neza says the trophy is heavier than expected and welcomes it as an addition to the collection.
